description.fun: Weedle's red-and-yellow colouring is a warning to predators, and it backs it up with a 5 cm venomous stinger on its head and a barbed one on its tail. Its keen sense of smell sniffs out its favourite leaves, and every day it eats its own weight in them. Its name mixes 'worm' and 'needle'.
description.guide: A Bug and Poison Pokémon resembling a larva, with a venomous stinger on its head and another on its tail. Its bright colours warn predators that it is poisonous. It evolves into Kakuna and then Beedrill.
description.tagline: A caterpillar with a needle on its head and a warning in its colours

description.fun: Kakuna hangs from branches on long strands of silk and stays almost perfectly still while it waits to evolve, growing warm to the touch as the moment nears. Don't mistake that for helplessness: if attacked, it can poke out poison barbs. Oddly, its English name sounds more Japanese than its Japanese one, which is simply Cocoon.
description.guide: The cocoon stage of Weedle's line, a yellow Bug and Poison Pokémon that hangs from branches by silk while it waits to evolve. It barely moves but can extend poison barbs when attacked, and its body heats up as Evolution nears. It evolves into Beedrill.
description.tagline: A dangling cocoon that's warm, still and not quite defenceless

description.fun: Beedrill fight as a swarm: disturb one and the whole group comes after you, flying at high speed with drill-like stingers on their forelegs and a third, most venomous one on the abdomen. They're especially protective of Weedle and Kakuna. Paired with Butterfree, it seems to echo the boxing line 'float like a butterfly, sting like a bee'.
description.guide: A large, wasp-like Bug and Poison Pokémon with venomous stingers on its forelegs and abdomen. It is very territorial and attacks in groups when disturbed. It is the final stage of Weedle's line and can Mega Evolve into Mega Beedrill.
description.tagline: A furious swarm of wasps with drills for arms

description.fun: Grows a third pair of wings and long, lance-like stingers. It stabs with fast-acting poison from its limbs to stop prey escaping, then finishes it with the slow-acting poison in its tail.
